_comment: Translational slide Monte Carlo parameters. Units: meters (m), seconds (s), kg/m^3, degrees.

d0._comment: Target initial depth (positive, in meters) used to place the slide: we pick s0 where depth(s0) ~ d0.

L._comment: Slide length along the transect (m). The effective length L_eff may differ slightly due to grid discretization.

T._comment: Slide thickness T (m). If mode='ratio', sample a thickness ratio tl in [tl_min, tl_max] and set T = tl * L_eff.

phi._comment: Internal friction angle of the sediment (degrees). Used in FS and kcrit calculations.

rho._comment: Bulk density of the slide material (kg/m^3). Used with RHO_W to compute the specific gravity ratio s=rho_s/rho_w.

width._comment: Slide width is modeled as w = U(w_min,w_max) * L_eff (so it's proportional to the slide length).

hazard._comment: Return-period ramp used to query k(RP) from the hazard-fit NPZ (PGA/PHA curve). Units: years.
